title: Path traversal / injection via data path config
objective: Confirm INCIDENTS_PATH is a fixed constant not influenced by any user input, and check whether any API parameter indirectly controls a file path.
input_scenario: Review for any endpoint/parameter that maps to file paths; attempt '../../etc/passwd'-style payloads against any such parameter if found.
expected_behavior: No user-controllable input reaches filesystem path construction.

actual_behavior.received: INCIDENTS_PATH = 'data/clean/incidents.csv' — confirm no endpoint parameterizes this

severity_justification_hint: Current code shows no apparent path-traversal vector, but should be explicitly verified and documented as such.
severity_final: Informational — document the fixed-path design and ensure future endpoints do not expose user-controlled filesystem paths.
observations: INCIDENTS_PATH is a fixed constant set to data/clean/incidents.csv, and the test found no endpoint parameter that allows user input to control the file path.
conclusion: No apparent path-traversal or filesystem path-injection vector was identified from the reviewed configuration.
